environment.description: Express application deployed on EC2 instance with IAM instance profile 'AdminPortalRole' that has iam:CreateUser, iam:AttachUserPolicy, iam:CreateAccessKey, and iam:DeleteUser permissions. No CSRF protection middleware installed. Application accessible via public ALB on port 443. Session cookies use SameSite=lax which permits cross-site form submissions via top-level navigation. No additional network restrictions or WAF rules applied.
